test_title: PYST 05: SSC Stenographer - English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 11 Dec 2024 - Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Parts of a sentence are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the parts in the correct order to form a meaningful sentence.

O) arid deserts

P) from lush forests to

Q) hikers encountered diverse ecosystems

R) trekking through the wilderness
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The paragraph describes the experiences of hikers as they encounter various ecosystems while trekking.
 
• **Sentence R is the first sentence** as it introduces the activity of trekking:
 
 
• "Trekking through the wilderness"
 
 
 
• **Sentence Q follows** as it talks about what the hikers encountered:
 
 
• "hikers encountered diverse ecosystems"
 
 
 
• **Sentence P is the third sentence** because it starts describing the range of ecosystems:
 
 
• "from lush forests to"
 
 
 
• **Sentence O is the fourth** as it completes the description of the range of ecosystems:
 
 
• "arid deserts"
 
 
 
• The correct sequence is **RQPO**.

 

**Coherent paragraph after rearrangement:**

"Trekking through the wilderness, hikers encountered diverse ecosystems from lush forests to arid deserts."
